provenance.selectionNotes: All 28 generated documentation pages are included. Queries are task-oriented search intents authored for this judged domain corpus rather than copied page headings.

review.method: Maintainer review of every query, grade, rationale, and measured top-five result.

rationales./docs/getting-started/installation.html: Provides the package installation commands, workspace setup, and build prerequisites.
rationales./docs/getting-started/overview.html: Provides useful orientation before following the installation procedure.

rationales./docs/getting-started/first-search.html: Walks through constructing a client and issuing the first search.
rationales./docs/reference/client-api.html: Documents the client methods and result fields needed by a search interface.
rationales./docs/guides/indexing.html: Explains the prerequisite index that the first search consumes.
Directly explains discovering rendered HTML and writing index artifacts.

rationales./docs/concepts/architecture.html: Describes the deployment topology connecting a static host to browser search.

rationales./docs/guides/ranking-and-boosts.html: Directly explains field boosts and their effect on title and body matches.
